text:
Priya: Quick thought — we need a more operational recruit flow for design partners that stamps each candidate with a primary use-case and a success metric. Current invites are too generic and we can't prioritize follow-ups.
Jordan: Agree. Proposed primary buckets: integrator, end-user app, regulated (compliance), and volume/throughput. Each gets tailored onboarding + success metric.
Sam: For regulated folks we should require an NDA + security call before access. That will slow down churn but is necessary.
Nina: What about acceptance SLA? If we promise a sandbox in 5 business days we need the infra playbook.
Tara: Can we keep two tracks: fast-path (2-week sandbox trial) and extended (custom onboarding 4-6 weeks). Fast-path = plug-and-play integrations, prescriptive prompts, 1 PM office hours.
Elaine: Success criteria should be measurable: activation (first API call), integration (first 5k tokens), feedback volume (>=3 structured issues), and NPS follow-up at week 3. If not met, schedule churn-retention review.
Priya: Love that. Let's make recruiter checklist include: primary_bucket, expected_volume, security_needs, success_metric, contact_person. Simple CSV schema will help ops.
Jordan: I'll sketch CSV with headers: candidate_id, company, primary_bucket, expected_weekly_tokens, security_flag, track, owner, start_date, target_metric.
Sam: Also add `blocked_by_compliance` boolean and `preferred_region` — lots of enterprise partners care about hosting region.
Tara: Playbook note: for fast-path do a 30-min setup call + 2 templated prompts. For extended track assign a Solutions Eng and plan 3-week integration sprints.
Nina: On evaluation: capture quantitative signals + 3 qualitative quotes per partner. Quant: latency/p99, cost per 1k tokens, model quality score from eval harness.
Elaine: We should gate public launch of any feature on two design-partner signoffs + zero-severity regressions on core prompts. That prevents surprise rollbacks.
Priya: Proposed recruitment prioritization: score = (strategic_weight) + log(expected_volume) + urgency_bonus - risk_penalty. Strategic_weight = 3 for regulated / partner ISV / marquee customer.
Jordan: Want the scoring to be transparent. I'll build a tiny Google Sheet that computes the score and flags top-10 recruits weekly.
Sam: Ops ask: we need tagging in Slack when we add a DP: `@dp-add` to create the record and auto-populate the sheet via webhook. Can infra support that?
Tara: I'll teach recruiters the tag vocabulary. Also will create 3 annotated examples in the playbook: one fast-path, one extended, one regulated.
ops-bot: Reminder: DP intake review Tue 9:30am PT — added `recruit-flow` as agenda item.
Priya: Owners: Jordan = scoring sheet + CSV schema, Tara = recruiter playbook + examples, Sam = security onboarding checklist, Nina = measurement dashboard spec, Elaine = launch gating rules. Please add items to the doc before Tuesday.
Jordan: I'll add a sample scoring formula and a mock list.
Sam: I'll draft the security checklist and required docs (NDA template link in doc).
Tara: Playbook draft by EOD Monday.
Nina: Dashboard spec will include cohort filters, metric trends, and a regression alert if quality_score drops >10%.
Priya: Final ask — everyone add one real candidate example to the sheet so we can sanity-check scoring. Quick turnaround ftw. :rocket:
